description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ClientRepository class within the OAuth module of OrangeHRM. It tests client retrieval and validation logic using unit tests with fixtures.

classes.name: ClientRepositoryTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the ClientRepository's functionalities such as fetching client entities and validating client credentials within the OAuth plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures by loading data from a YAML fixture file using the TestDataService.

methods.name: testGetClientEntity
methods.description: Tests retrieving client entities by ID, including cases for valid, disabled, and non-existent clients.

methods.name: testValidateClient
methods.description: Tests validating clients with various IDs, secrets, and OAuth flows to ensure the ClientRepository correctly authenticates and handles different scenarios.
